note: Promised minimum hours of power per day under NERC's Service-Based Tariff (SBT, from 1 November 2020). Bands A to E are verified from NERC's own FAQ page on electricity tariffs (https://nerc.gov.ng/faq/electricity-tariffs/), which lists 'Band A: Minimum of 20 Hours' through 'Band E: Minimum of 4 Hours'. The page is HTML, so there is no page number. NERC's 2021 public notice and 2020 press release (PDFs) independently confirm the 12-hour boundary between Bands C and D. No figure here is invented.

bands.name: Band A
bands.note: NERC FAQ 'Electricity Tariffs' (https://nerc.gov.ng/faq/electricity-tariffs/, HTML, no page number) lists Band A: Minimum of 20 Hours. Read 2026-11-15.

bands.name: Band B
bands.note: NERC FAQ 'Electricity Tariffs' (https://nerc.gov.ng/faq/electricity-tariffs/, HTML, no page number) lists Band B: Minimum of 16 Hours. Read 2026-11-15.

bands.name: Band C
bands.note: NERC FAQ 'Electricity Tariffs' (https://nerc.gov.ng/faq/electricity-tariffs/, HTML, no page number) lists Band C: Minimum of 12 Hours. Read 2026-11-15. The 2021 public notice (PDF, page 1) separately confirms bands D and E are served less than an average of 12 hours a day.

bands.name: Band D
bands.note: NERC FAQ 'Electricity Tariffs' (https://nerc.gov.ng/faq/electricity-tariffs/, HTML, no page number) lists Band D: Minimum of 8 Hours. Read 2026-11-15.

bands.name: Band E
bands.note: NERC FAQ 'Electricity Tariffs' (https://nerc.gov.ng/faq/electricity-tariffs/, HTML, no page number) lists Band E: Minimum of 4 Hours. Read 2026-11-15.
